name: Menen Asfaw
contribution: Empress of Ethiopia as the wife of Emperor Haile Selassie.

checks.lead: Menen Asfaw (baptismal name: Walatta Giyorgis; 25 March 1889 – 15 February 1962) was Empress of Ethiopia as the wife of Emperor Haile Selassie.
